title: Turn the root README into a short guide
description: README.md today is a feature description: it explains what SOBER is, lists the loop, and links to packages/*-plugin for host detail. Reshape it into a guide someone follows top to bottom on their first day: (1) what SOBER is — keep the existing opening and "Three jobs at once", trimmed; (2) Install — `npm i -g @besober/cli`, Node 22, then `sober init` in a git repo; (3) Install the plugin for your host — a section per host, see the decision on where that prose lives; (4) First board — the actual command sequence a new user types: `sober init`, `/sober:plan <intent>`, `/sober:decide`, `/sober:next`, `sober dashboard`; (5) The loop table and the one hard block, kept as they are; (6) When not to use it; (7) Docs and Development, kept. Keep the Hosts capability table (plugin / decisions in session / attended run) — it is the only place the per-host differences are comparable side by side, and the guide should point at it from the install section.

brief.approach:
Rewrite README.md in place. Nothing else is touched: the four package READMEs, docs/ and the Hosts table's link targets stay exactly as they are, and this node writes no install prose for any host — that is `a-per-host-install-section-in-the-readme-ykg6`, which lands into the anchor this node leaves behind.

The decision `where-does-the-canonical-per-host-instal-elpx` was answered `root-canonical`, so the README is being reshaped to become the place a reader installs from without leaving the page. This node builds the shape; the next one fills it.

Section order after the rewrite:

1. **Opening** — logo, `# BE SOBER!`, the three existing paragraphs. Keep verbatim; they are the best-written prose in the repository and nothing about the guide asks them to change.
2. **Three jobs at once** — keep the three bullets (orchestration, automation, education) and the "what SOBER is not" paragraph. Trim only if a sentence repeats the opening.
3. **Install** — `npm i -g @besober/cli`, Node 22 or newer, the existing "that is the whole installation" sentence, then `sober init` in a git repository and what `.sober/` and the `sober-graph` branch are. Unchanged content, moved under a step number.
4. **Install the plugin for your host** — heading and one paragraph only: the shared prerequisite (`sober` must be on PATH, because every host's MCP declaration and Claude Code's hooks.json name that command) and a sentence saying the four hosts follow. Leave the section empty below that paragraph — a literal `<!-- per-host install sections land here: node ykg6 -->` comment marks the anchor. Do not write Claude Code's or anyone else's commands here.
5. **Your first board** — new, and the reason this node exists. The command sequence a newcomer types, in order, each with one line on what it does and who owns it: `sober init`, `/sober:plan <what you want built>`, `/sober:decide`, `/sober:next`, `sober dashboard`. Point at the loop table below rather than explaining the loop twice.
6. **The loop** — the existing table, unchanged, and the "status is derived, never set" paragraph.
7. **The one hard block** — unchanged.
8. **Where you work** — unchanged.
9. **Hosts** — the existing capability table, unchanged, with a line above it saying the install commands for each are in section 4. This is the only place the per-host differences are comparable side by side and it stays a table.
10. **When not to use it** — unchanged.
11. **Docs** and **Development** — unchanged.

Rules for the rewrite: every link target that exists today still resolves afterwards. No fact about a host is invented here — sections 4 and 9 make claims only where the repository already backs them. `packages/claude-code-plugin` still has no README at this point, so the Hosts table keeps pointing at the directory; `write-the-missing-readme-for-packages-cl-sshg` changes that row, not this node.

acceptance.proves: biome and secretlint both pass over the rewritten README — no secret and no formatting violation was introduced by the edit
README.md is the only file the node changed; the package READMEs, docs/ and the manifests are untouched

acceptance.run: rg -o '\]\(([^)#][^)]*)\)' -r '$1' README.md | grep -v '^https\?://' | while read -r p; do test -e "$p" || { echo "missing: $p"; exit 1; }; done
acceptance.proves: every relative link in the README resolves to a file or directory that exists — the Hosts table rows, the docs table and the package links all still point at something

acceptance.run: rg -q '^## Your first board' README.md && rg -q '^## Install the plugin for your host' README.md && rg -q 'per-host install sections land here' README.md
acceptance.proves: the two new sections exist and the anchor comment that node ykg6 fills is present, so the next node has somewhere to land

acceptance.run: rg -q 'npm i -g @besober/cli' README.md && rg -q 'sober init' README.md && rg -q 'sober dashboard' README.md
acceptance.proves: the install command, the init command and the dashboard command all survived the restructure — the guide can still be followed end to end
